messages:
samir: Heads-up — Sandbar (dedicated pool d-42) is hitting token/s SLO violations. We're seeing sustained 2x expected TPS for the last 20m, admission control returning 429s and burst_credits now 0.
ops-bot: [ALERT] dedicated-pool/d-42 token_surge threshold crossed at 2026-03-17T15:02:56Z. Current TPS: 11200 (SLO: 5000).
mike_support: pinging Sandbar's account team and PM. Any immediate customer impact reported?
samir: Yes, customer reported elevated 429s and tail latency spikes in their ingest pipeline around 14:48Z. They say this started after a sudden campaign.
ingrid: grabbing recent admission logs and kvcache stats. Quick grep shows repeated admission.fail.reason=burst_credits_exhausted and admission.queue_depth spikes.
anya: @samir can you share the exact metrics and which model family? We need to know if it's a single model hot path.
samir: Model: redwood/gpt-traffic-v2 (quantized). Traffic concentrated on route /v1/generate with variable seq lenses. Attaching quick snapshot:
```
# metrics snapshot
pool: d-42
window: 2026-03-17T14:40Z-15:00Z
avg_tps: 9800
peak_tps: 11200
burst_credits_start: 12000
burst_credits_end: 0
admission_429_count: 420
median_server_latency: 280ms -> 540ms
```
neal: Noted. Autoscaler logs? Did we see any scale up events or stuck prewarm?
ingrid: Autoscaler attempted 2 scale-ups but both failed with prewarm_timeout on node-provision step. Provisioner errors show EC2 quota errors for p4x large (we're hitting regional capacity).
mike_support: Customer says they cannot reroute to hosted fallback; they are on Dedicated with traffic pin. Any emergency fallback option?
anya: Two immediate mitigations: 1) Temporarily increase per-account admission headroom if pool headroom available elsewhere, 2) Apply short windowed token rate-limit at ingress (customer side) to smooth. But both need ops approval.
samir: Trying a quick policy change: increase admission.headroom_pct for tenant sandbar from 10% to 25% on pool d-42. If successful we can drain some queue. Running command:
```
redctl admission update --pool d-42 --tenant sandbar --headroom 25
```
ops-bot: Command accepted, queued for rolling update.
ops-bot: admission.policy.update for tenant=sandbar applied on 4/6 nodes.
ingrid: Policy applied but no immediate drop in 429s — credits already zeroed and queue backlog persists.
neal: Since we can't provision new GPUs in region, we should test cross-region failover to a compatible pool (d-17 in us-west). That requires customer consent for latency tradeoff.
mike_support: Sandbar PM approved temporary cross-region failover for 30m. Initiating routing override and setting model variant to redwood/gpt-traffic-v2-8q (less tokens/sec).
samir: Applying routing override:
```
redctl route set --tenant sandbar --pool d-17 --model redwood/gpt-traffic-v2-8q --duration 30m
```
ops-bot: Route override accepted. Traffic shifting 0->30% now.
anya: Also raising billing-bot alert: sandbar consumed burst credits early; need to check invoice/accounting for burst credit consumption anomaly.
billing-bot: Billing alert queued: possible burst credit spend spike for tenant sandbar between 14:30-15:10Z. Owner: @finance.
samir: Repro plan notes for eng-runtime: 1) Replay customer traffic (captured at 14:45Z) against small test pool with same config, 2) Try incremental headroom tweaks and observe admission metrics, 3) Validate autoscaler behavior when prewarm fails due to capacity.
ingrid: I uploaded the admission logs and replay capture to s3://redwood-debug/sandbar/2140029876/replay.tar.gz. Link: https://s3.redwood.internal/sandbar/replay.tar.gz (internal access only).
mike_support: Customer accepted the cross-region failover and reports 429s dropping to near 0 after shift to 60% traffic on d-17 and model variant. Latency increased ~40ms median but service usable.
samir: Post-mortem action items: - Improve early-warning for burst_credit burn rate - Add fallback routing automations when pool capacity provisioning fails - Add quota monitoring on provisioning paths (prevent silent prewarm_timeouts) - Billing: surface burst credit spend spikes to customer dashboards.
anya: I'll own the billing dashboard item. @neal and @ingrid can you take autoscaler/provisioner follow-ups?
neal: On it — will triage provisioner logs and file infra bug.
ingrid: Will run replay tests and produce a short repro doc with commands and expected metrics.
mike_support: I'll send the customer a summary and temporary credits if finance approves. :handshake:
samir: Thanks team — keeping thread open until replay results and autoscaler fix tracked. If anything changes I'll update here.
_meta: generated by dataset-gen: support thread about dedicated token/s burst and admission control
